findings.evidence: grep finds the `(h : q = p) {w : TangentSpace I q}` pattern only in these new private helpers: Action.lean:177, Tangent.lean:119, FixedPoints.lean:90/97. There is no existing public version.
findings.fix: Add one public lemma (inner, with the norm version derived from it) in the Riemannian bundle basics file. Delete both private copies and use the public lemma in both files.
findings.issue: `private theorem inner_congr` (equal base points give equal inner products) is a general RiemannianBundle fact, not tied to isometries. `Tangent.lean:119` adds the norm version `private norm_congr`, which repeats it. Other files will have to re-prove it.

findings.evidence: Both proofs are just `subst h hw; rfl`. Neither statement mentions an isometry or a group action.
findings.fix: Make them public next to `riemannianExp_def` (Geodesic/Exponential.lean:122) and next to the definition of `maximalGeodesic`.
findings.issue: `private maximalGeodesic_congr` and `private riemannianExp_congr` are basic congruence lemmas for `maximalGeodesic` and `riemannianExp`. They don't depend on isometries or fixed points.

findings.evidence: The statement only involves `AlmostComplexStructure V`, `Representation ℝ G V`, `IsComplexLinearMap J J` and `Module.End.invtSubmodule`.
findings.fix: Move it to `TauCeti/Geometry/Symplectic/AlmostComplex.lean` next to `isComplexLinearMap_iff_apply` (line 427), or to a small file that imports both AlmostComplex and Representation.
findings.issue: `TauCeti.AlmostComplexStructure.invariants_mem_invtSubmodule` is only about almost complex structures (no symplectic form), but it sits in the symplectic invariants file. Anyone looking for it in the almost complex structure API won't find it.

findings.evidence: grep finds `mfderiv_mem_ball_of_apply_eq_self` only at its definition and in the module docstring. Every use in FixedPoints.lean calls the `smul` version.
findings.fix: Keep one map-level lemma: if `f p = p` and `mfderiv f p` preserves the inner product at `p`, then it maps balls about 0 into themselves. Derive the isometry case from it, or drop the unused one.
findings.issue: The public `RiemannianIsometry.mfderiv_mem_ball_of_apply_eq_self` has no consumer. It repeats `TauCeti.mfderiv_smul_mem_ball_of_smul_eq_self` (Action.lean:197), and each one carries its own private transport helper.

summary: The new surface hides general helpers as `private`: four lemmas move vectors between the tangent spaces at equal points, and two of them repeat the same idea in separate files. It also misplaces an almost-complex-structure lemma in a symplectic file and adds a public ball lemma with no consumer that duplicates another.
